data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'Tun' meaning enclosure or settlement, and 'sweorde' meaning person or warrior. This name translates to 'settlement by the town's person'. Historically, Townsend may have referred to someone who lived near or in charge of a town or settlement. The name Townsend carries the meaning “Settlement by the town's person” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Townsend usually hope their child will grow to embody settlement by the town's person and live with faith, good character and purpose.
